citations.quote: An den Aussenwänden unserer Wohnung läuft das Kondenswasser herunter, und an praktisch allen Fensterrahmen wächst Schimmel.
Nachts fällt ausserdem regelmässig der Heizkessel aus, die Schlafzimmer sind dann am Morgen kalt.
Weil wir uns über die Ursache nicht einig werden, muss jetzt ein unabhängiger Bausachverständiger die Wohnung untersuchen.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and agreed tenancy terms.
Obtain the reported emails and registered letter to establish what defects were reported and when.
Delivery evidence is needed to establish whether and when the landlord received the reports.
Dated images are needed to document the visible defects and affected locations.
Obtain the responses and any proposed work or access arrangements.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations would support the condition assessment.
Heating failures are reported; request any service findings and inspection dates.
Health effects are not mentioned and are presumed absent for planning.
An independent inspection is reported as needed; obtain any existing findings while keeping the cause open.
A rent deposit is not mentioned and is presumed not considered for planning.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: When did the defects begin, which rooms are affected, and are there any immediate health or safety concerns?
When were the reports delivered to the landlord, and were inspections, repairs or access arrangements proposed?
Has an independent inspection or heating service visit already taken place? If so, are reports available?
